scope: Review of outcome-dependent race work and similar avoidable backend operations

decision.recommended: Retain the existing lightweight trajectory check for earned completion effects; avoid competitive projections and presentation work when their authoritative inputs are unchanged.
decision.competitive_gate: Use neither improvement, not either failure: no race PB, no flying-lap PB, no weekly slot-best improvement or first completion, and no challenge/stage-best or exact source-result need. Comparisons must use the same pinned board and current server state.
decision.rank_is_insufficient: A faster weekly slot time remains useful while rank and immediate points stay unchanged; it is the retained best used for later comparisons and tie handling.
slower_race_effects: 50 completion coins and potentially 200 clean-race coins
A flying-lap PB and its reward despite a slower race total
Achievement counts, distance, biome/car progress, precision and streak updates
Challenge completion/goal rewards and independent limited-start accounting
Creation of a new challenge from this exact slower result
decision.full_bypass_limit: PB/weekly rank comparisons alone cannot justify trusting an unverified finish for all existing earned effects. A different reward-evidence policy would need a separate explicit product decision. This review changes neither reward promises nor trust policy.

findings.title: Distinguish completion validation from competitive updates
findings.current: Ordinary acceptance already performs one Python trajectory pass with cached prepared geometry; it does not run native physics per race. Slower/tied race-PB upserts are already avoided.
findings.proposal: Retain this completion check while gating downstream work by actual changes. Keep creator validation, first weekly/stage completions, lap PBs and exact post-race challenge sources eligible.

findings.title: Defer separate ghost storage for attempts with no retained competitive use
findings.current: Worker needs_ghost is true for all ordinary real players and writes a separate optional ghost object before finalization, including slower races. The original submitted envelope may also contain the ghost.
findings.probe: A slower Rivalry attempt kept the old PB and earned 50 coins, but stored a separate ghost.
findings.proposal: Persist standalone presentation ghosts for actual retained race/weekly/challenge sources. Recover a slower exact challenge-source ghost on demand from retained evidence, following the existing ensure_ghost pattern. Keep storage outside scoring locks and handle concurrent winners. A later negotiated proof-first/ghost-on-demand upload protocol could additionally remove unnecessary upload bytes.
findings.limits: Skipping the standalone copy alone does not remove ghost bytes embedded in the proof object. Dropping those bytes needs a separate durable upload/recovery protocol and exact post-race-source retention.

findings.title: Reuse unchanged Rivalry standings inside acceptance
findings.current: Rivalry acceptance computes before and after standings even when improved is false. Achievement comeback evaluation can compute them again.
findings.probe: The slower two-member fixture called standings_data twice from accept_verified and once from capture_race, with improved=false and zero point delta.
findings.proposal: Reuse the before snapshot for after when the weekly slot best does not change; share appropriate transaction-local standings with achievement evaluation. Continue writing the exact attempt outcome and use actual weekly time improvement, not rank movement, as the gate.

findings.title: Return only status while challenge verification is pending
findings.current: Every challenge result poll builds and returns a full current challenge snapshot, including standings, route metadata, rewards and attempts.
findings.probe: One queued two-person challenge-result request executed 24 SQL statements and returned a 2540-byte decompressed response body, with one full snapshot call.
findings.proposal: Negotiate a compact pending response containing ticket status and retry timing. Load the current complete snapshot at terminal transition or when its relevant revision changes. Share the existing run completion wait/cache across modes.
findings.limits: Requires matching capability-gated client changes because the current challenge client validates a snapshot on every poll. Preserve current account/content authority and cancellation/expiry handling.

findings.title: Combine terminal result, reward receipt and changed account revisions
findings.current: Run status already includes Rivalry outcome but not challenge outcome or coin receipt. reward_for performs its own receipt GET and triggers a wallet refresh; achievement refresh is separate.
findings.proposal: Extend the authoritative terminal response with the once-only coin receipt, challenge/Rivalry outcome and appropriate wallet/achievement revisions. Consume those values with account and revision fencing, fetching other views only when their revision changed.
findings.limits: Report committed state; never use an older terminal response to overwrite a newer wallet or achievement state. Preserve archived receipt recovery. Existing batched run statuses and Rivalry result reuse are already implemented and should remain.

findings.title: Avoid unchanged multi-track challenge aggregate rewrites
findings.current: After all stages have times, series acceptance sums all stage bests and overwrites member.run_id on every accepted slower attempt, even when no stage best changed.
findings.proposal: Recompute the stored aggregate only after a stage-best/first-completion change. Preserve per-attempt receipts, start consumption, result feedback and protected exact source references; review representative run_id semantics explicitly.
findings.validation: Source inspection; no separate SQL savings benchmark.

findings.title: Skip newspaper record-candidate reads when neither PB changed
findings.current: capture_verified queries both PB source projections for every eligible accepted race, then returns immediately when neither references the current run.
findings.proposal: Carry exact race/lap improvement flags from the existing acceptance facts and skip this candidate query when both are false. Keep first-time reach, record announcements and source eligibility behavior.
findings.validation: Source inspection; no separate SQL savings benchmark.

already_present: Cached immutable verification geometry and lightweight acceptance without native simulation
Shared acceptance-fact read and reuse of verified results after finalization SQL failure
Batched run-status polling, bounded signal-assisted waits and Rivalry receipt reuse
Persistent ghost cache, shared GETs, prepared immutable responses, packing and cold receipt archives in the existing cost implementation
